scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev:memory --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
